description.en: The streaming domain or ingest domain.

title.zh: 查询指定直播域名证书信息

descriptions.zh:
先获取直播域名，再调用本接口获取指定直播域名证书信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You must specify a domain name whose certificate information you want to query.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-certificate-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
